rule: Reuse the exact same model, age, proportions, hairstyle, costume, colors and signature equipment. Front and three-quarter poses are welcome. Only a mouth may be visible; hide human eyes, eyebrows and noses entirely under hair, hood or solid ink shadow. Animals and monsters may show complete faces and eyes.

cast.name: Rowan
cast.hair: messy curly dark brown bangs, fully obscuring upper face
cast.costume: teal cloak, gold leaf embroidery, round sun clasp, cream rolled sleeves, dark leather vest and trousers, brown laced boots, bracers and fingerless gloves
cast.equipment: one gold-hilt longsword in a dark scabbard at left hip, leather satchel
